(A') PE1..PE4 observed 0.841/0.915/0.906/0.870 vs published 0.841/0.905/0.914/0.896, max deviation 0.026; PE is unrenumbered so this is corroboration, not inference. PD1-PD10 likewise unrenumbered. DOES NOT ESTABLISH: the order of the six retained STP items among themselves. The published STP loadings (0.823-0.971) are not reproduced in magnitude by any subset of this block (max live PC1 loading 0.86), so no per-item STP statistic discriminates; live STP2 vs STP4 in particular (loadings 0.719/0.715, means 2.738/2.788) are not separated by any route found. Those six rest on the order-preserving renumbering convention, which is proven for KN by (A) but not re-proven inside STP. Hence PARTIAL, not VERIFIED.
